archiveReason: This toolkit specification belongs to a larger product composition, not a standalone component in the curated index.
missingReference: TBD: an isolated primitive example and component reference.

productControls.name: Button
productControls.reason: Shared action control, independent of any feature workflow.

productControls.name: Split button
productControls.reason: A default action with a separate menu of alternatives. ButtonWithDropdown exists, but an isolated reference is TBD.

productControls.name: Menu button
productControls.reason: A trigger that opens actions rather than selecting a field value. DropdownMenu exists; its primitive reference is TBD.

productControls.name: Icon toggle
productControls.reason: An independently checked mode, not a mutually exclusive radio option.

productControls.name: Action bar
productControls.reason: Foundational action grouping and keyboard navigation, without a feature toolbar model.

productControls.name: Button bar
productControls.reason: Elementary grouping of related buttons, not a feature-specific command surface.

productControls.name: Link
productControls.reason: Navigation to a destination, distinct from running an action. A shared Link exists outside base UI; its primitive reference is TBD.

productControls.name: Input box
productControls.reason: Shared text entry and validation states.

productControls.name: Text area
productControls.reason: Multiline text entry. InputBox supports a flexible-height textarea, but a dedicated primitive reference is TBD.

productControls.name: Combobox
productControls.reason: Editable text with suggested choices. Product evidence is a composed editor-backed input, not a standalone combobox contract; content is TBD.

productControls.name: Checkbox
productControls.reason: An independent form choice; separate from immediate settings switches and icon toggles.

productControls.name: Switch
productControls.reason: An on/off setting that takes effect immediately.

productControls.name: Radio group
productControls.reason: Shared mutually exclusive selection, including the product’s segmented presentation.

productControls.name: Select box
productControls.reason: Shared single-selection dropdown; not the composed multi-select action widget.

productControls.name: Multi-select
productControls.reason: Selection of several values from a known set. The current platform widget is composed; reserve the primitive contract without using its composite preview.

productControls.name: Field label
productControls.reason: A visible name associated with an input, distinct from highlighted display text. A shared field-label reference is TBD.

productControls.name: Highlighted label
productControls.reason: Reusable text and match highlighting, not a form-field label.

productControls.name: Icon label
productControls.reason: A shared name, optional icon, and description without a resource or feature model.

productControls.name: Keybinding label
productControls.reason: Platform-aware shortcut notation; it displays a binding without registering one.

productControls.name: List
productControls.reason: A reusable collection with row focus and selection. Feature lists do not substitute for an isolated primitive reference.

productControls.name: Tree
productControls.reason: A hierarchical collection with expansion, focus, and selection, independent of Explorer or another feature.

productControls.name: Table
productControls.reason: A reusable row-and-column collection. The shared Table API qualifies independently of fixture registration.

productControls.name: Tabs
productControls.reason: Selection between peer content panels. Current editor tabs are composite product evidence, not a general-purpose tabs primitive; content is TBD.

productControls.name: Breadcrumbs
productControls.reason: Navigation through a hierarchy. BreadcrumbsWidget is reusable without the editor breadcrumb model; its isolated reference is TBD.

productControls.name: Count badge
productControls.reason: Reusable count indicator, not a feature status badge.

productControls.name: Status indicator
productControls.reason: Compact information, warning, or error status. SeverityIcon supplies glyph classes, not a complete accessible indicator reference; content is TBD.

productControls.name: Message
productControls.reason: A reusable message with severity, supporting text, and optional actions. Current notification rows are composites; the standalone building block is TBD.

productControls.name: Progress bar
productControls.reason: Shared progress feedback, without a feature-specific task model.

productControls.name: Pixel spinner
productControls.reason: Shared indeterminate busy indicator, not a chat-specific loading illustration.

productControls.name: Tooltip
productControls.reason: Brief supplemental text for a control. The shared hover shell alone does not demonstrate tooltip triggers, keyboard access, or dismissal; content is TBD.

productControls.name: Hover
productControls.reason: An anchored surface for richer supplemental content, distinct from a brief tooltip. Editor hovers and the motion surface demo are not isolated primitive references.

productControls.name: Menu
productControls.reason: Reusable action-menu behavior, separate from feature-specific menu contents.

productControls.name: Dialog
productControls.reason: Reusable modal surface. Product callers should normally use the dialog service.

productControls.name: Separator
productControls.reason: A visual or semantic boundary between related groups, not a layout engine. A dedicated reusable reference is TBD.

productControls.name: Scroll area
productControls.reason: A reusable viewport with scrollbars and overflow affordances. ScrollableElement exists; a primitive reference is TBD.

productControls.name: Resize handle
productControls.reason: A user-facing divider for resizing adjacent regions. Sash qualifies; the grid and split-view engines around it remain infrastructure.

families.reason: Choose a suggestion or enter a text value.
Select several values from a known set.

families.name: Field
families.reason: Associate an input with its visible label, help, and validation.
Browse, focus, and select rows in a collection.

families.name: Notification
families.reason: Present a message, severity, and optional actions.
Show brief supporting text on hover or keyboard focus.

families.name: Hover card
families.reason: Preview richer supporting information near its trigger.
Choose an action from a menu, with optional submenus.
Present a focused modal decision with actions and optional inputs.
Separate groups of related content or actions.
Navigate overflowing content through a shared scroll viewport.
Resize adjacent regions with a draggable divider.

additions.name: Collapsible pane
additions.reason: Expand or collapse a content region through its header.

additions.name: Quick Pick
additions.reason: Filter a collection and choose an item without leaving the current task.

additions.name: Resource pill
additions.reason: A compact resource reference with an optional menu and trailing actions.
